scope: Agreement sought on performance experiments toward stronger work; no claim that current art scores nine.

challenges.claim: PB1: weak small held-pose separation risks the mischievous signature.
challenges.position: Retain as a thumbnail concern; reject static recognition as the decisive comic test.
challenges.evidence: motion.js:135–145 authors two peeks separated by concealment. all-24.png supplies only the 1550-ms pose, excluding that reversal.
challenges.resolution: Test the whole beat and selected static fallback separately; strengthen neither automatically.

challenges.position: The source supports the timing fact, not a demonstrated weight defect or mandatory later compression.
challenges.evidence: motion.js:194–199 already coordinates descent, head compression and antenna reversal at 1060 ms; exact-case-8 preserves tiny contact geometry.
challenges.resolution: Observe the baseline first. Try later head recovery only if playback identifies weight loss; pre-contact head movement can be intentional anticipation.

challenges.claim: PB3: similar total durations and smoothstep may homogenize rhythm.
challenges.position: Keep the hypothesis, but total runtime mixes active response with settling and holds.
challenges.evidence: Surprised reaches its lifted-head key at 540 ms; Thinking stages a separate toe tap at 2590–2770 ms. motion.js:115–128,294–304.
challenges.resolution: Compare time to readable reaction and accent spacing, not equalize or shorten whole clips.

agreements: Keep tiny anatomy, matched theme poses, purposeful hand hierarchy and the corrected descent.
Source curves and frame sheets establish mechanics; playback and observer responses establish different evidence.
Silence, finite endings and restrained wings remain valid choices.
differences: A prioritizes a coherent thought and comic reversal; B prioritizes onset, contact and temporal contrast.
A proposes baseline observation before retimed alternatives; B proposed immediate current-versus-alternative comparisons.

prioritizedExperiments.action: Show current Mischievous, Surprised, Thinking and Excited silently, unlabelled, once at intended small and larger sizes. Capture descriptions, first readable response and any float/stop; include one relevant replay/interruption.
For a demonstrated failing beat only, compare one variable: peek reveal/hold, surprise onset, or head recovery around contact. Preserve amplitude and anatomy; retain baseline if benefit is unclear.
Place one current Curious thought change beside a real content cue to test gaze intention; do not require new scenery.

acceptanceCriteria: Both reviewers identify stimulus/attention, response and settlement in actual-size playback; record any disagreement.
Mischief reveals an intentional peek rather than only sleep/contentment; startle and contemplation have distinguishable rhythms.
Hop contact/recovery reads coherently without added height, foot separation or interruption-induced bounce.
Record unlabelled human descriptions and confusions separately from AI judgments; no unsupported recognition percentage or nine score.
remainingObjections: No observed continuous playback or audience responses yet; hypothetical failures cannot justify wholesale retiming.
Static fallback selection may need its own solution even when comic playback succeeds.
ADecision: Approve this bounded experiment plan; not final-art approval.
